name: triangular prismatic elements
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 具有三角形截面的棱柱形有限单元。

complete_examples.text: In this work, a isoparametric element permutation method is proposed, where the 6-node triangular prismatic elements and 8-node spatial isoperimetric elements have been effectively integrated to achieve the finite elemental modelling of the soil system with the tunnel penetrating.
From Fig. 4, it is known that the soil nodes belonging to triangular prismatic elements can be determined by scanning the grid line by line.
